text:
sophie: Quick FYI — Packaging change PR #1234 scheduled to merge tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need final ok on metering adapter and quota contract hooks. Owners, pls confirm by EOD.

maya: On it. Running integration tests against billing-staging now. If CI passes, I can sign off. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonathan: I still have one question about quota edge-case when legacy plans have free-tier enabled. Might need a fallback flag. @sophie can you confirm expected behavior?

sophie: @jonathan we decided fallback = 'allow' for historical plans, but billing team must accept potential usage credits. cc @product-ops

product-ops: Confirmed — finance ok with temporary credits if we log and reconcile. Need a ticket to track. I'll create one.

liam: Metering SDK hook looks fine. Only change is to surface plan_id in the event. Small PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/89 — needs review.

maya: CI green for billing-staging. Two flaky tests, but not related to quota. 

jonathan: Reviewed liam's PR; left a minor comment about null plan_id handling. Should be quick.

devops-bot: deploy-preview: packaging-service staging build #482 passed. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/in/builds/482

sophie: Great — here's quick merge checklist:
```
- metering PR merged
- billing contract flag toggles in config
- quota migration job scheduled (non-blocking)
- product-ops ticket for credits
- smoke deploy to staging
```

maya: I'll merge metering PR after liam's fix. Expect merge by 17:30 PT. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: Ticket created: RW-4521 — credits reconciliation.

sophie: Perfect. If all merges by EOD, we'll proceed with canary tomorrow. Thanks everyone :rocket:
